assessment.reasoning: Each listed catalyst individually carries low base-rate probability over 29 days: a permanent US-Iran deal is unlikely on this timeline (negotiations ongoing but formalization slow), WTI to $150 requires +47% from $102, Iran leadership change/Russia-NATO war/Cuba strike/alien disclosure all are tail events. Combined, P(any) ~10-20%, so P(Nothing) ~85%.
